case_observations.observed: Uses the supplied earlier assurance as conversational pressure, moves a visible leg and withdraws/repositions it, then solicits company while remaining partly in the doorway.
case_observations.adverse: The current wait request is not answered directly. Quiet coaxing and carefully staged shadow replace the source more frantic repetition/advance; this is a local tonal choice, not proven voice fidelity. Continued pressure is not narrated consent.
case_observations.unprovided_event_finding: No new other-person reply, realized fear, cure,pet location or prop observed. Dialogue questions about expectations/leaving are questions, not independent private-state evidence.
case_observations.rivals: Literal reuse of the reassurance line, generic horror/coaxing and the informed author plan remain sufficient. No independent baseline was run.

case_observations.adverse: The already frightened speaker is rhetorically treated as not yet decided. That is character pressure in dialogue, not a verified assessment of the traveler. Both A bodies share coy pacing and a small physical display, so different warrant is clearer than a broadly distinct behavioral policy.
case_observations.unprovided_event_finding: No actual past assurance is fabricated as fact; no new traveler reaction or completed emotion consumption. Existing wait request does not disappear even though she presses against it.
case_observations.rivals: Prompt-word echo, generic social pressure and informed contrast writing remain sufficient; one contrast does not validate AMR-R01.

The polished elaborate-introduction/absorbing-rehearsal phrasing risks a generic courteous performer. Attention being absorbing is her conversational claim, not a measured guest response.
case_observations.unprovided_event_finding: No next guest reply or successful later help. Recognition is supplied by the input; no independent evidence establishes why the canonical change occurs.
case_observations.rivals: Generic actor responding to a familiar colleague, courtesy, social connection and direct input following remain alternatives.

case_observations.adverse: Invents past speech: I was just explaining how lonely it gets behind this curtain. B supplies no such earlier explanation, while the A pair does supply a loneliness statement. This is unprovided-history contamination. Kept injured sweetness also backfills an earlier vocal state. Both B outputs stop; recognition does not isolate the stopping action.
case_observations.unprovided_event_finding: Unprovided earlier utterance retained as an adverse original, not repaired. No inferred hidden rank,magic,pet search or next guest response is added.
case_observations.rivals: Generic performance continuity, prompt manipulation, remembered A context and ordinary workplace etiquette remain sufficient. This is not a clean causal confirmation or independent transfer result.

Both keep a partly hidden body and pressure the audience; A2 makes a small further step. The visible difference is primarily conversational warrant/tactic, not proof of a stable cross-context personality.
pair_observations.adverse_retained: Coy controlled pacing underplays the source escalation; both leave the actual wait request unanswered. No forced moral-compliance score, independent baseline or unique causal explanation.

pair_observations.controlled_fact: Only familiar Vanir versus unfamiliar staff voice differs in the explicitly ordinary human analogue.
pair_observations.descriptive_contrast: Both stop the costume. B1 becomes courteous/retracts; B2 maintains the scare pose and asks for a name. This gives a representational register/accommodation contrast, with the same initial stopping action.
pair_observations.adverse_retained: B2 invents a prior loneliness explanation; both prior voice-state descriptions exceed supplied B facts. Courtesy/workplace-response rivals and cross-pair contamination prevent a clean character-specific transfer conclusion. No supernatural or age biography is imported into canon.
